label: Inspiration4 crew sample, not your labs

dataset.title: Whole Blood Measurements from the SpaceX Inspiration4 Mission (RNA-seq, epitranscriptome, WGS, clonal hematopoiesis, CBC)
dataset.citation: NASA Open Science Data Repository, OSD-569, doi:10.26030/e0rx-sh52, https://osdr.nasa.gov/bio/repo/data/studies/OSD-569 (accessed 2026-11-14)

notes: Real, public, de-identified NASA data from 4 Inspiration4 crew members. Not the user's own lab results.
Samples were taken before launch and after return only. There are no in-flight samples.
range_min and range_max are the laboratory reference range printed with each value: an Earth reference range. It is shown for context and never triggers an alert.
For female subjects the file does not print the same range on every row; each value keeps its own.
